answer.exemplar: Chain rule: -sin(x^2)*2x. The outer derivative is -sin, inner derivative 2x.

questions.explanation: The rule that settles this the chain rule item is: Outer times inner. That is why "Chain rule: -sin(x^2)*2x" is the answer.

options.text: On an open interval, absolute extrema may not exist

questions.stem: Explain the derivative of x*ln x.

answer.exemplar: Product rule: 1*ln x + x*(1/x) = ln x + 1.

questions.explanation: The the product rule principle here is: Add both terms. On that basis "Product rule: 1*ln x + x*(1/x) = ln x + 1" is correct.
